description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between different prompting strategies—CoT, CoD, CCot, and CoUT—and their corresponding accuracy percentages and token counts. The horizontal axis displays the prompting strategy categories: CoT, CoD, CCot, and CoUT, listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis on the left represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, and tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis on the right represents token count, labeled as “Token Count”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, and tick marks at intervals of 100. Four bars are present, each corresponding to a prompting strategy. The CoT bar is red and extends to approximately 91.19% accuracy with a token count of 676.85. The CoD bar is orange and reaches approximately 88.50% accuracy with a token count of 534.24. The CCot bar is green and extends to approximately 80.89% accuracy with a token count of 445.91. Finally, the CoUT bar is blue and reaches approximately 75.46% accuracy with a token count of 354.46. The bars are not visually emphasized, and are arranged in the order of the prompting strategies listed on the horizontal axis.
